headline: Fire at Iraq's Hartha power station near Basra kills at least four people
headline_es: Incendio en la central eléctrica de Hartha, cerca de Basora, deja al menos cuatro muertos
caption_en: A fire at the Hartha power station north of Basra, in southern Iraq, killed at least four people and injured at least 30 on Saturday, according to Iraqi officials. Civil defence crews brought the blaze under control after it spread to nearby homes and forced the plant to stop operating. The 800-megawatt station had been running at about 400 MW, and the cause has not been officially confirmed.
caption_es: Un incendio en la central eléctrica de Hartha, al norte de Basora, en el sur de Irak, mató al menos a cuatro personas e hirió a al menos 30 este sábado, según funcionarios iraquíes. La defensa civil controló el fuego después de que se extendiera a viviendas cercanas y obligara a detener la planta. La central, de 800 megavatios, operaba a unos 400 MW, y la causa aún no ha sido confirmada oficialmente.
summary_es: El fuego en la central de Hartha, al norte de Basora, se extendió a casas vecinas y obligó a parar la planta. La causa no ha sido confirmada.
summary_en: The blaze at the Hartha plant north of Basra spread to nearby homes and halted operations. The cause has not been confirmed.
